description:
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, earthbending The Stasis Coffin, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate The Stasis Coffin by paying {2}, tapping and exiling it.
The Stasis Coffin triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Stasis Coffin ability from step 2, causing you to gain protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.
